hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | tee -a /tmp/pre_claudecode_tooluse.log | grep -qE 'git commit'; then echo 'Reminder: run the pre-commit-review skill (code-review) and resolve all issues before completing this commit.' >&2; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | tee -a /tmp/post_claudecode_tooluse.log | grep -qE '\bgit push\b'; then echo 'A git push was just made. Use the post-push-review skill now: watch the code-review GitHub Action run for this branch, then fetch and resolve any PR review comments/issues it reports, committing and pushing fixes, repeating until clean or asking the user if something cannot be resolved automatically.' >&2; fi
